title: AARO Satellite Flaring Paper
doc_notes: This is an AARO information paper explaining how satellite flaring can be misinterpreted as UAP, and it contains one specific case study of a pilot report.

encounters.summary: An airline pilot reported multiple unidentified lights moving in different directions near Gallup, NM, which AARO determined were likely Starlink satellite flares.
encounters.quote: multiple lights moving in different directions, left of the constellation Leo
